gcloud.title: Google Cloud
gcloud.description: Google Cloud console APIs: projects, service enablement, API keys, billing, monitoring, storage, BigQuery and IAM, plus the rest of the infrastructure, data, devops, networking, security and governance APIs.

gsc.title: Search Console
gsc.description: Search Console sites, sitemaps, search analytics, URL indexing and site verification.

gsearch.title: Search and Web Quality
gsearch.description: Public search and web-quality APIs (Custom Search, PageSpeed, CrUX, Safe Browsing, Web Risk, Fact Check) that take an API key instead of OAuth. The Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers and is scheduled to be discontinued on 2027-01-01.

gdrive.title: Google Drive and Docs
gdrive.description: Google Drive files, labels and activity, plus Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms and Books.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.description: Gmail mailboxes, messages, labels and settings, plus Gmail Postmaster Tools.

gcalendar.title: Google Calendar
gcalendar.description: Google Calendar calendars, events and calendar settings.

gchat.title: Google Chat
gchat.description: Google Chat spaces, messages and members, plus Workspace Events subscriptions.

gmeet.title: Google Meet
gmeet.description: Google Meet spaces, conference records, participants and recordings.

gcontacts.title: Contacts and Profile
gcontacts.description: Google Contacts and People, personal health metrics, Data Portability, and the OAuth2 userinfo endpoints.

gtasks.title: Tasks and Keep
gtasks.description: Google Tasks task lists and tasks, plus Google Keep notes.

gclassroom.title: Google Classroom
gclassroom.description: Google Classroom courses, coursework, submissions, students and teachers.

gapps.title: Apps Script
gapps.description: Apps Script projects and execution, plus the Workspace Marketplace SDK.

gadmin.title: Workspace Admin
gadmin.description: Google Workspace administration: Cloud Identity, Chrome management and policy, Groups Settings, licensing, reports, alerts, Vault, reseller and Cloud Search admin.

ganalytics.title: Google Analytics
ganalytics.description: Google Analytics admin and data APIs for GA4 properties, configuration and reports.

gtm.title: Tag Manager
gtm.description: Google Tag Manager accounts, containers, tags, triggers and variables.

gyoutube.title: YouTube and Blogger
gyoutube.description: YouTube Data, YouTube Analytics and YouTube Reporting APIs, plus Blogger.

gbusiness.title: Business Profile
gbusiness.description: Business Profile accounts, locations, verifications, lodging, place actions, notifications and performance.

gads.title: Ads and Publisher
gads.description: Google Ads API (accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, budgets, conversions, assets and GAQL reporting, with every other method through the gateway), plus advertising and publisher APIs: Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager, Ad Exchange, AdSense, AdMob, Real-time Bidding and more.

gmerchant.title: Merchant Center
gmerchant.description: Merchant Center: Merchant API, Comparison Shopping Service and Manufacturer Center.

gplay.title: Google Play
gplay.description: Google Play developer publishing and reporting, Play Games Services, Android Enterprise and Management, Play Integrity and device APIs.

gfirebase.title: Firebase
gfirebase.description: Firebase management, App Check, App Distribution, Crashlytics, Hosting, Data Connect, Rules, Test Lab, FCM and Identity Toolkit.

gmaps.title: Maps and Location
gmaps.description: Maps Platform and location APIs: Places, Address Validation, Solar, Air Quality, Pollen, Street View Publish and related datasets.

gai.title: AI and ML
gai.description: Generative and classic AI APIs: Discovery Engine, Vertex AI, Dialogflow, Vision, Speech, Translate, Document AI and agent services.

notes.googleads: Generated: 33 per-method tools for the core Google Ads resources, in this order: accounts (listAccessibleCustomers, mutate, createCustomerClient), GAQL search and searchStream, googleAdsFields, campaigns and campaign budgets, account budget proposals, ad groups, ads and ad group ads, keywords (ad group and campaign criteria, negative keywords, keyword ideas, keyword theme and geo target suggestions), conversion actions and goals, bidding strategies, and assets (asset groups, asset sets, and the account, campaign and ad group asset links). The include list is a list of resource or method paths: a path names every method of a resource, or one method. The other 141 methods (reporting forecasts, audiences, experiments, labels, batch jobs and so on) are reached through the gateway with api_search, api_describe and api_call. Media upload is not supported by the gateway. Every mutate method is dynamic: validateOnly true is a read, a remove operation is destructive, and any other change is a write.
notes.displayvideo@v4: Generated subset: 116 per-method tools for the advertiser workflow (advertisers, campaigns, insertion orders, line items, ad groups and ad group ads, creatives, ad assets, negative keywords, channels, location lists, targeting options, audiences, invoices, floodlight groups, SDF download tasks and YouTube asset associations). The other 60 methods (partners, users, inventory sources, guaranteed orders, custom bidding, reach forecasts and so on) are reached through the gateway. The whole document is still snapshotted, so every OAuth scope of the API is granted at login.
